scope: Compiled mouse-cursor descriptor table and the DisplayClass::SetCursorFromAction action-to-row switch. Static reads of the executable; no native execution and no rendered pixels.
limits: Row semantics (which game state selects which action) are not established here; only action -> row and row -> frames.
A row with count > 1 and rate 0 is recorded as stored; how the original advances such a row is not established.
Two switch entries derive their row from a call (0x00731CC0, 0x00731CB0); the callee's result is not recorded.
The descriptor table has no stored length: the row count comes from the layout check above, and the action count from the dispatch's own bound. Both are recorded with the derived value, not assumed.
